text: im confused on what ur doing. we had water already going into the ground, i came to you said there is a crack between the water and the ground. that somehow turned into making water a jello brick. i said wtf is that, water is in the ground, now the ground doesnt look like water at all but i just fall into it
resolution: User was frustrated that the wedge/crack fix (bb19793b0) over-corrected: forcing the water surface flat + dilating it under the wall + bolder waves turned painted water into a jiggling 'jello brick' that no longer read as water, so the dug region just looked like a hole they fall into. Reverted floorToWaterBody to the original per-cell surface (bed+depth per wet cell) and WATER_WAVE to the gentle ripple (0.1/5/0.22) — exactly the bb8ac1388 state the user had and liked (water sitting in the ground). Commit 751626804. The original small edge crack between water and the basin wall is back; it should be addressed minimally and separately WITHOUT changing the water's appearance. Kept the unrelated depth-only slider (7f7fbfc25). 6/6 water tests pass; editor hot-reloads, compiled needs a game bake to drop the reverted grid.
